name: Sidecar
description: A bright, brandy-based sour from the 1920s: cognac, orange liqueur and lemon.

steps.text: Chill a coupe with ice and water while you build the drink.
Optional: dump the coupe, moisten half the rim with lemon and dip it in {superfine-sugar}.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake hard.
Express {orange-peel} over the drink and garnish.

source.name: Harry MacElhone, Harry's ABC of Mixing Cocktails (1922)
